items.title: 9.8.3 Weak acids aur strong bases ke salts (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.8.3, printed page 205.

blocks.text: Weak acid aur strong base ke salt ki misal sodium acetate hai: CH3COONa(s) + H2O(l) se CH3COO-(aq) + Na+(aq). CH3COO- weak acid CH3COOH ka conjugate base hai aur pani se react karta hai, CH3COO-(aq) + H2O(l) se CH3COOH(aq) + OH-(aq). Na+ strong base NaOH ka conjugate acid hai aur pH par asar nahi karta. CH3COO- ion ki wajah se solution basic hai.

blocks.prompt: Potassium carbonate ka solution alkaline hai. Wazahat karein aur hydrolysis ka muadla dein (Quick Check 9.5d).
blocks.explanation: K2CO3 se K+ aur CO3 2-. Strong base KOH ka K+ react nahi karta, magar carbonate weak acid HCO3- ka conjugate base hai aur pani se proton leta hai: CO3 2- + H2O se HCO3- + OH-. Chhora gaya OH- solution ko alkaline karta hai.

items: Weak acid + strong base salt (CH3COONa): CH3COO- hydrolyse ho kar CH3COOH + OH- deta hai, Na+ nahi; solution basic.
